svg.title: How clawock grades a call
svg.desc: The model writes a versioned decision with its strategy, condition, regime, size and confidence into memory/decisions.jsonl. From there the model has no write access. Python evaluates the trigger against canonical unadjusted daily bars on each market's own calendar; an unfinished session grades nothing and a gap through a trigger fills at the open. Repeated calls on one thesis collapse into one episode. Code settles the outcome and scores it against a plain directional baseline, then publishes wins, losses and the cases that cannot be graded, which stay visible and out of the win-rate denominator. The record is a diagnostic, not proof of return.
